title: Factory Aisles
event: Overhead panels slide down and floor fixtures unlatch: checkout islands fold into low conveyor modules and the central atrium reconfigures into a narrow industrial corridor. The lighting snaps from warm retail to cold, clinical fluorescents and metal tracks click into place along the ceiling, forcing circulation into a single scraped lane.
consequence: A thin streak of dark oil is dragged across the new corridor floor, cutting from the escalator toward the meat cases.
nextHook: oil streak crossing the atrium toward displays
stillPrompt: Wide, high-angle view of the familiar Kaufhaus central atrium transformed into a temporary factory: retail shelving telescopes inward, checkout desks hinge down into metal belts, exposed ceiling tracks and hanging metal panels cast hard shadows. People are tiny, blurred. No signage, no text, no monster. Cold fluorescent light throws hard reflections on tile; a fresh dark oil streak runs along the newly formed corridor between escalator and aisle.
videoPrompt: Start on a stable crane shot from the atrium loft. Animate the slow mechanical folding of checkout islands into conveyor modules, the lowering of ceiling panels and the click-and-slide of metal tracks. Convey the rearrangement by moving the camera forward along the new corridor until the oil streak comes into frame, glinting under harsh lamps. Do not introduce any creature.
cameraCue: After the rearrangement finishes, push the crane down and forward to reveal the oil streak at floor level, then hold.

title: Pulsing Displays
event: Refrigerated display cases in the produce and meat section begin to pulse as if under a heartbeat: thin, raw-looking membranes unfurl inside trays and the packaged surfaces ripple and weep a viscous red glaze. One aluminum tray tears and slides onto the floor, spilling a tacky residue.
consequence: A torn tray leaves a congealed, semi-solid residue that creeps toward the aisle and the earlier oil streak.
nextHook: congealed residue advancing along the floor toward the mall walkway
stillPrompt: Tight three-quarter shot of a row of refrigerated display cases: the glass fogged, the metal edges slick. Inside, packaged trays flex and a fleshy, fabric-like membrane peels back to reveal wet interior folds; droplets bead and run. One tray rips with a metallic whisper and slides to the tile, leaving a shiny, bobbing residue that begins to creep away. Shoppers are out of focus behind the glass. No monster, no readable text.
videoPrompt: Slow dolly along the front of the refrigerated row. Animate the rhythmic pulsing of trays, the membranes peeling back, droplets gathering and a tray tearing free to slide onto the floor. Track the residue as it oozes toward the aisle and joins with the previously visible oil path. Keep all attention on objects and materials; do not show any creature.
cameraCue: Low tracking close to the tray edge, follow the torn tray as it slides and leave the camera static as the residue begins to creep.

title: Iridescent Warning
event: The congealed residue reacts: it fizzes and flattens into a thin iridescent film that spreads across the tiles. The film refracts the harsh fluorescents into strobing hazard colors; small plastic safety tags and clipped fasteners—no readable printing—tear free from shelves and spin like petals over the film. A localized incandescent point flares where fizz concentrates, scorching the glaze into a circular black ring.
consequence: A perfect round scorch imprint appears on the tile where the film bubbled most intensely.
nextHook: the circular scorch mark on the tile, stained and warm
stillPrompt: Floor-level view: a spreading sheet of iridescent film on store tile, thin rainbow sheens catching and breaking overhead light into frantic bands. Plastic safety tags spin down onto the film and wobble. Near the center a small bright ember appears and burns a clean circular scorch into the floor. No monster, no readable text. The atmosphere smells of ozone and warm metal (implied).
videoPrompt: Handheld low sweep across the tile as the iridescent film ripples outward and the plastic tags twirl and settle. Animate the fizzing of the residue and the flash of an incandescent bead that leaves the circular scorch. Track the shimmer and end on the fresh scorch as people and fixtures shift in the background.
cameraCue: A low, slightly jittery push that follows the film to the moment the ember flares and reveals the round scorch.

title: Ordered Panic
event: Shoppers react to the warning-like spectacle with an almost choreographed response: they funnel into ordered chains, moving with the discipline of an evacuation drill. The crowd forms rigid human lanes around the scorch. A small child drops a plush toy; it bounces, slides and comes to rest half-melted against the scorched ring. Security staff form a slow ring, pushing carts into makeshift barricades.
consequence: A half-melted child's toy sits pressed to the scorch, its fur congealed and its plastic eye clouded.
nextHook: the scorched toy lying against the floor's burned ring
stillPrompt: Mid-shot in the aisle: rows of people moving in synchronized, deliberate lines around the scorch. Their faces are blanked by motion blur; bodies form ordered lanes. At the center a small plush toy slides and stops, its fur singed where it touches the black ring. No monster appears; the scene reads as a public response to hazard.
videoPrompt: Crane down from shoulder height to reveal the human patterns forming and the toy sliding into the scorch. Animate the crowd's slow, coordinated movement and the toy's small, final skid. Keep focus on people and the toy; do not introduce any creature.
cameraCue: Start wide to show the ordered crowd, then tighten to follow the toy as it collides with the scorch and settles.

title: Figure at the Center
event: A weathered practical sculpture already occupies the central floor at the beginning of the shot: a seven-foot assemblage of burlap, rusted sheet metal, patched plumbing fittings, hand-stitched seams and ground-in dirt, with mismatched glass marbles inset as eyes and faded cloth draped like a coat. The crowd treats it as a focal threat. Panic cascades: alarms ping, fixtures collapse into jagged chutes, and people surge; a heavy, wet footprint is stamped into the glazed tile beside the scorch and the toppled displays.
consequence: A deep, oily footprint stamped into the floor glaze beside the scorch; several displays lie toppled around it.
nextHook: the monster's heavy footprint leading toward checkout and the conveyor system
stillPrompt: Location-reanchored wide shot of the Kaufhaus atrium: the weathered practical sculpture stands inert in the center—burlap, rusted sheet panels, stitched seams, plumbing joints, glass marbles for eyes; it reads as an object, not as a digital creature. Around it a ring of toppled fixtures and a fresh, deep oily footprint beside the scorch. People are in mid-panic, caught around the figure. No readable text or logos. The sculpture is clearly a constructed, weathered prop filmed in the space.
videoPrompt: From the still start frame where the sculpture is already present, animate the human panic: alarms, collapsing fixture chutes, people surging and security forming a ring. Do not animate a reveal or entrance of the sculpture; the figure remains in-frame but static besides minimal settling and subtle breathing. Track a falling display as it knocks a metal basket, producing the heavy footprint impression into the glaze. Focus motion on people and falling architecture, not on the sculpture's arrival.
cameraCue: After the collapse, drop to a low angle behind the sculpture to reveal the oily footprint and toppled displays in the foreground, the crowd receding in the background.

title: Appraisal and Receipt
event: Store systems begin to reassert operational logic: conveyor belts and checkout mechanisms activate and accept the scorched toy and the residue as items to be processed. Mechanical arms lift the toy, slide it across sensors, and an automated repackager stacks new shrink-wrapped units around the footprint. Scales tilt, coin trays rattle, and product modules reorganize so the damaged spot becomes the center of an automated packaging ritual—the terror residue turning into stock.
consequence: A compact stack of newly packaged merchandise is assembled around the footprint; the conveyor hums toward a closed service door.
nextHook: conveyor carrying packaged bundle toward the staff-only door at the back
stillPrompt: Close, clinical shot of conveyor belts and a mechanical arm at a checkout line. The half-melted toy is clamped, passed across a scanner, and placed into a repackager which coldly builds a neat stack of shrink-wrapped items around the footprint on the floor. Scales and coin trays respond with mechanical clicks; no people or creatures in frame. The machine-like consumption gesture translates the chaos into packaged goods.
videoPrompt: Animate the conveyor starting, the arm grabbing the toy, the scanner lights cycling, and the repackager compressing a tidy bundle that is pushed toward a staff-only service door. Small gears and coin trays rattle; the camera tracks the bundle as it moves away. Do not show or reference the sculpture or any creature.
cameraCue: Low, lateral glide that follows the bundle along the conveyor as it departs toward the closed service door, ending on the door's seam.

title: Appraisal: The Item
event: At the shot's start the weathered practical sculpture is visible again, placed awkwardly atop a conveyor pallet amid packaged stacks. The store's machinery appraises it like merchandise: a forklift attachment slowly lifts the figure and nudges it toward a scanning aperture; a sensor projects a faint, sterile wash over its weathered surfaces and the footprint on the tiles is imprinted into a glossy tag-like wound. The machine’s motion is methodical—terror translated into commodity—and the conveyor pulls the sculpture toward a locked service door.
consequence: The sculpture-monster is placed on a conveyor and pulled through the staff door; a final oily smudge remains on the tile where it stood.
nextHook: the staff-only door closing over the conveyor as the final smudge is left behind
stillPrompt: Location-reanchored medium-wide shot of the atrium: the same weathered practical sculpture (burlap, rusted panels, stitched joins, glass marble eyes, patched plumbing fittings) is already seated on a pallet. Forklift tines nest beneath it; a conveyor mouth glows where sensors sweep its surface. Machinery reads, touches and reclassifies the object; the tile beneath retains a damp oily smudge. No readable text, filmed practically in the Kaufhaus.
videoPrompt: From the pre-existing start frame, animate the forklift lowering, the pallet tilting and the sensor wash passing over the sculpture. Show the conveyor taking up the pallet and pulling it slowly through a seam in the staff-only door until it disappears. The sculpture moves only as an already-present object being lifted and conveyed—no entrance or materialization. End as the door closes and the oily smudge remains.
cameraCue: Tight dolly that moves from the sculpture's patched face down to the pallet, then follows the pallet as it slides into the door and hold on the closing seam.
